experiments.name: Run missing required assays
experiments.notes: Placeholder umbrella experiment when one or more required metrics are absent. Use the gate to determine which assays are missing.

experiments.name: QC review of existing measurements
experiments.notes: Neutral suggestion to perform a QC review step so strict-mode selection can accept or reject evidence deterministically.

experiments.name: Repeat assay or review QC failure
experiments.notes: Used when evidence is excluded due to QC failure. Either repeat the assay or validate the QC rationale.

experiments.name: Fix parser or re-import to recover numeric value
experiments.notes: Used when a metric exists but the stored value is text/boolean such that numerical evaluation cannot proceed.

experiments.name: Resolve metric alias conflict
experiments.notes: Used when the same conceptual measurement appears under multiple metric keys (canonical vs aliases).

experiments.name: Run a functional assay
experiments.notes: Functional anchor metrics include percent_killing, ec50, or pass_fail depending on assay design.

experiments.name: Run internalization or surface expression assay
experiments.notes: Used when a binding affinity (kd_nM) is present but interpretability requires internalization/surface expression context.

experiments.name: Run endotoxin assay
experiments.notes: One concrete example of a required assay family.

experiments.name: Run SEC-HPLC purity profile
experiments.notes: One concrete example of a required assay family for purity/integrity gates.

experiments.name: Run PK screen (optional gate)
experiments.notes: Optional; used when study intent requires PK evidence.
